targetDir.description: Cross-platform path-form superset: absolute target path or path beginning with ~. Runtime accepts only native-platform absolute/path forms after expansion.

homeLabel.description: Label for paths below current machine home directory; native Windows CWD case differences share mapping identity, while POSIX paths remain case-sensitive.

rootLabel.description: Label for absolute paths not covered by homeLabel or extraPrefixes; labels remain semantic after decoding.

extraPrefixes.description: Cross-platform path-form superset of absolute path prefixes mapped to non-empty portable labels; runtime applies native-platform path validation. Foreign Windows-shaped keys are accepted intentionally for cross-machine target decoding; on Windows, decoding returns the configured prefix spelling while identity comparisons fold case.
